Welcome to the official YouTube channel for WQOW 18 News, the Chippewa Valley's source for breaking news, 18 Storm Track Weather, and area sports. From the heart of Eau Claire to Chippewa Falls, Menomonie, and beyond, We've Got You Covered.

🔔 SUBSCRIBE for daily updates on:

Breaking News: Fast and accurate reporting on the stories shaping Eau Claire and the Chippewa Valley.

18 Storm Track Weather: The most trusted weather team in Western Wisconsin, providing your daily AM Forecast and severe storm tracking.

You Ask, We Answer: Our community-driven investigative series where we get the answers to your local questions.

Digging Deeper: In-depth research and reporting on what you want to know about.

STAY CONNECTED 24/7: 🌐 Visit our Website: WQOW.com 📧 News Tips: Email News@WQOW.com or call our newsroom at (507) 895-1919.
